name: Bad Teacher Brian
source:
It’s that time of the month again!
You and your colleagues from the local college have your monthly night out at a local cafe. And you’ve decided that this time, you will reach your goal.

Your goal of finally seducing Brian!

You’ve known him for a while now and have been interested in him ever since the first meeting month’s ago. Brian, on the other hand, has been quite enjoying showing off his body whenever he can and however he can! Often seen stripping out of his clothes, mouthing off in his foul-mannered speech, complaining about the god damn heat, incompetent concierges and stupid punks that don’t know shit.

So the question is…

Will this be your lucky night? Can you reach third base?

[From the [url=https://oonyxgames.com/game/bad-teacher-brian/] official website[/url]]
translation:
又到了每个月的这个时候了！
你和你当地大学的同事每月都会在当地的咖啡馆度过夜晚。你已经决定，这一次，你一定会实现你的目标。

你的目标是最终诱惑布莱恩！

你已经认识他有一段时间了，自从一个月前第一次见面以来，你就对他感兴趣了。另一方面，布莱恩非常喜欢尽可能地展示自己的身体！经常有人看到他脱光衣服，大言不惭地说着粗俗的话，抱怨该死的炎热，无能的礼宾人员和不懂事的愚蠢小混混。

所以问题是……

这会是你的幸运之夜吗？你能到达三垒吗？
